requirements.description: User prefers properties near public transport. Set at the 75th percentile (70.93, rounded to 71) of the mobility distribution, since 'preferred' signals a proximity need.
The user explicitly requires at least 180 sqm of gross floor area.

output.sql: SELECT * FROM ESTATES WHERE property_type = 'Attività scolastiche' AND surface_area >= 180 AND haversine_km(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) <= 3.0 AND mobility >= 71 ORDER BY haversine_km(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) ASC
output.explanation: Filters school-type properties (Attività scolastiche) with surface_area of at least 180 sqm, within 3.0 km of the given coordinates, and mobility score >= 71. Results are ordered by haversine distance from the coordinates. The capacity requirement (14 people) has no matching column and is ignored; energy class is not filtered.
